openings.claim: Transfer remembering pattern quantities and noticing missing units to a pencil-drawn counting surface on each existing envelope: write the assigned pattern and one numbered cell per required material unit, grouped by material and specified dimensions. Empty cells expose incomplete picks before filling; the exterior pattern name remains available at distribution.
openings.delta: Tray tags identify material types and samples depict finished contents. The envelope instead carries this kit's required count and assignment at the point of assembly. Volunteers copy specifications, place actual units beside their cells, verify dimensions, and insert the complete array immediately. Maintaining accurate markings and replacing obscured ones remain volunteer work; insertion errors still require human checking.
openings.prediction: With local material proximity held constant, marked envelopes will expose more incomplete picks before insertion and require fewer finished-kit corrections than unmarked envelopes. Preparation time may erase any throughput gain; no benefit has been observed.
openings.rival_prediction: The nearest alternative is simply loose materials beside each volunteer, as stipulated in O4. If proximity explains accuracy, equally local unmarked kits will have similar omission rates and finish faster without marking overhead.
openings.defeat: Matched local-material trials show no additional missing-unit detection, or volunteers mark cells complete while kits still lack items. A projected total exceeding 90 minutes defeats adoption for the original task even if accuracy improves.
openings.probe: Use exactly two volunteers for an 18-minute capped trial, including drawing and immediate contents checks, wholly on the existing table. Alternate six marked and six unmarked kits with matched assigned-pattern mixtures and identical local supply access. Record incomplete picks, finished omissions and elapsed time on existing tally sheets; preserve every required quantity and dimension. Stop if the layout cannot fit. Include preparation and checking when estimating a later 60-kit trial.
assumptions: Fit evaluates the bounded probe; completion of all 60 kits within 90 minutes remains unproven.
Existing envelopes have enough writable area for legible cells without affecting use.
Verified pattern specifications can be accurately copied from existing samples.
The local-material layout fits alongside existing supplies; opened-packet footprint is unconfirmed.
